troubleshooting.title: How to find & connect your watch
troubleshooting.steps:
1. Make sure the HealthSense watch is powered on.
2. Turn on Bluetooth and Location Services on your phone.
3. Bring the watch close to the phone (within 1 metre).
4. Make sure the watch is not paired with another phone.
5. Tap the Refresh button in the top-right corner to scan again.
